ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Estimated 30:70 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (concentrated at distal tips) to low-intensity black pixels (dominating the central and proximal surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous geometric clusters are located at the lateral distal tips of both lobes; high-frequency white/grey mottling transitions medially from the tips; central region adjacent to the notch is solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide V-shaped depression with an approximate 110-degree interior angle and shallow depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3-10 units; most pronounced along the distal 60% of both trailing edges, smoothing slightly as they approach the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge trajectory with sharp convex curvature at the lateral lobe terminations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white pixel circularities located at the extreme distal points of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized surface encrustation.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical, high-intensity linear scar (approx. 45 pixels in length) visible on the left lobe (viewer's left), oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct vertical white linear scar on the left fluke lobe; irregular, jagged morphology at distal lobe tips indicating historical tissue loss or significant barnacle attachment sites.
